backend: local Rust Laya and DuckDB spatial
scope: Example execution and full result comparison with exact status filters

deep_wells_near_jev_pipeline.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID
FROM deep_wells_m w
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pipelines_m p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(w.geom_m, p.geom_m, 5000)
    AND jev({'current_phase': p.current_phase},
            'Is this pipeline currently in service?')
)
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;
deep_wells_near_jev_pipeline.reference_sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID
FROM deep_wells_m w
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pipelines_m p
  WHERE ST_Distance(w.geom_m, p.geom_m) <= 5000
    AND p.current_phase = 'IN SERVICE'
)
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;

jev_pipelines_intersecting_discovery.sql:
SELECT p.OBJECTID
FROM pipelines_m p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM discovery_areas d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(p.geometry, d.geometry)
    AND jev_choice({'current_phase': p.current_phase},
                   'What is the pipeline lifecycle state?',
                   ['in service', 'decommissioned', 'abandoned']) = 'in service'
)
ORDER BY p.OBJECTID;
jev_pipelines_intersecting_discovery.reference_sql:
SELECT p.OBJECTID
FROM pipelines_m p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM discovery_areas d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.geometry, p.geometry)
    AND p.current_phase = 'IN SERVICE'
)
ORDER BY p.OBJECTID;

discoveries_containing_jev_deep_wells.sql:
-- Diagnostic: DRILLING can pass this model threshold incorrectly.
SELECT d.OBJECTID
FROM discovery_areas d
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM deep_wells_m w
  WHERE ST_Contains(d.geometry, w.geometry)
    AND jev_prob({'status': w.status},
                 'Does the well status explicitly say that it is operating?') >= 0.5
)
ORDER BY d.OBJECTID;
discoveries_containing_jev_deep_wells.reference_sql:
-- Diagnostic: DRILLING can pass this model threshold incorrectly.
SELECT d.OBJECTID
FROM discovery_areas d
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM deep_wells_m w
  WHERE ST_Within(w.geometry, d.geometry)
    AND w.status = 'COMPLETED (OPERATING)'
)
ORDER BY d.OBJECTID;

nearest_jev_pipeline_to_deep_well.sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID AS well_id, nearest.pipeline_id, nearest.distance_m
FROM deep_wells_m w
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p.OBJECTID AS pipeline_id,
         ST_Distance(w.geom_m, p.geom_m) AS distance_m
  FROM pipelines_m p
  WHERE jev({'current_phase': p.current_phase},
            'Is this pipeline currently in service?')
  ORDER BY distance_m, p.OBJECTID
  LIMIT 1
) nearest
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;
nearest_jev_pipeline_to_deep_well.reference_sql:
SELECT w.OBJECTID AS well_id, nearest.pipeline_id, nearest.distance_m
FROM deep_wells_m w
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT p.OBJECTID AS pipeline_id,
         ST_Distance(w.geom_m, p.geom_m) AS distance_m
  FROM pipelines_m p
  WHERE p.current_phase = 'IN SERVICE'
  ORDER BY distance_m, p.OBJECTID
  LIMIT 1
) nearest
ORDER BY w.OBJECTID;
